description: Source code implementing various filters for listing objects in a Git repository, including filters for object types, size limits, depth, sparse checkout, and combination of filters.

classes.name: subfilter
classes.description: Represents a subfilter with its own seen and omit sets, and skip tree info.

classes.name: filter
classes.description: Defines a filter with function pointers for object filtering, finalization, and cleanup.

classes.name: filter_trees_depth_data
classes.description: Holds data for depth-based tree filtering, including seen trees at different depths.

classes.name: seen_map_entry
classes.description: Represents an entry in the seen map with object ID and depth.

classes.name: filter_blobs_limit_data
classes.description: Stores size limit for blob filtering.

classes.name: frame
classes.description: Represents a directory frame in sparse checkout filtering, with pattern match result and omission status.

classes.name: filter_sparse_data
classes.description: Holds data for sparse checkout filtering, including pattern list and directory stack.

classes.name: filter_object_type_data
classes.description: Stores object type for filtering specific object types.

classes.name: combine_filter_data
classes.description: Holds subfilters for combined filtering logic.

methods.name: filter_blobs_none
methods.description: Filter that includes all tags, commits, and trees, but omits blobs.

methods.name: filter_blobs_none__init
methods.description: Initializes the 'filter_blobs_none' filter.

methods.name: filter_trees_depth
methods.description: Filters trees based on depth, omitting trees and blobs beyond a certain depth.

methods.name: filter_trees_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with depth filter data.

methods.name: filter_trees_depth__init
methods.description: Initializes depth-based tree filter.

methods.name: filter_blobs_limit
methods.description: Filters blobs based on size limit, omitting large blobs.

methods.name: filter_blobs_limit__init
methods.description: Initializes size-limited blob filter.

methods.name: filter_sparse
methods.description: Filters objects based on sparse checkout patterns, including directory and blob filtering.

methods.name: filter_sparse_free
methods.description: Frees resources for sparse filter data.

methods.name: filter_sparse_oid__init
methods.description: Initializes sparse checkout filter from a blob OID.

methods.name: filter_object_type
methods.description: Filters objects by specific object type (commit, tag, tree, blob).

methods.name: filter_object_type__init
methods.description: Initializes object type filter.

methods.name: process_subfilter
methods.description: Processes a subfilter for the combine filter, managing seen and skip states.

methods.name: filter_combine
methods.description: Combines multiple subfilters, only showing objects passing all filters.

methods.name: filter_combine__free
methods.description: Frees resources for combined filter.

methods.name: filter_combine__finalize_omits
methods.description: Finalizes the union of omit sets from subfilters.

methods.name: filter_combine__init
methods.description: Initializes a combined filter with multiple subfilters.

methods.name: list_objects_filter__init
methods.description: Creates a filter based on specified options and filter choice.

methods.name: list_objects_filter__filter_object
methods.description: Applies the filter to an object, deciding whether to show, skip, or mark.

methods.name: list_objects_filter__free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a filter.
